settings.title: Service
settings.text: From the first conversation to delivery, one team in Portugal designs, samples and makes your rug. Production takes [lead_weeks] weeks, or [priority_weeks] with priority production.
settings.image_alt: A mood board of rug samples, patterns and colour references

settings.title: Personalized consultation
settings.text: Every bespoke project begins with a personalized design consultation, where we explore your vision in detail. Together, we discuss design, material selection, pile height, and every subtle detail to ensure the rug perfectly suits your space and purpose.
settings.image_alt: A designer touching rug samples on a wall of materials

settings.title: We design your idea
settings.text: Your vision is our starting point. Our design team transforms your ideas into tangible proposals, sending exclusive artworks for approval, ensuring every detail aligns with your expectations before we move to production.
settings.image_alt: A designer drawing rug artwork on two screens

settings.title: Sampling process
settings.text: Before final production, we offer a meticulous sampling process. You can approve the design, texture, and colours, making certain that every element perfectly reflects the rug you envisioned.
settings.image_alt: A square sample of a carved, high-pile rug in beige and brown

settings.title: Rug production
settings.text: Every rug is crafted with utmost care and attention to detail, using only the finest materials. Production takes [lead_weeks] weeks, or [priority_weeks] with priority production.
settings.image_alt: A tufting gun working yarn into a rug by hand

settings.title: Delivery & shipment
settings.text: We work with a network of trusted local partners around the world, ensuring each shipment and delivery is handled with care and adapted to the specific needs of every project.
settings.image_alt: The edge of a finished rug, with the Corvo label, trimmed by hand

settings.title: How an order runs
settings.text: What we commit to, and what we ask of you, on every order.

settings.label: Proposal
settings.value: For a design of your own, we send a proposal: the artwork of your rug, its price and its production time.

settings.label: Confirmation
settings.value: We confirm an order within 3 business days. You approve the order confirmation within 2 business days.

settings.label: Changes
settings.value: An order can be changed or cancelled up to [change_hours] business hours after we confirm it.

settings.label: Production
settings.value: [lead_weeks] weeks. [priority_weeks] weeks with priority production, for [priority_percent]% more. A custom colour, design or shape can take longer: the date is in your order confirmation.

settings.label: Delivery
settings.value: Worldwide. Delivery is not included in the price: it is quoted for each order.

settings.label: Quality
settings.value: Every rug passes a quality control and is photographed before it leaves us.

settings.label: If something is wrong
settings.value: Tell us in writing within [claim_days] business days of receiving the rug, with photographs.

settings.label: Returns
settings.value: Every rug is made to order, so it cannot be returned or exchanged.

settings.label: Your project
settings.value: We do not publish photographs of a project without the client's consent.

settings.title: For architects and designers
settings.text: We work with architects and interior designers on residential and contract projects.
settings.image_alt: The Corvo showroom, with rugs and samples displayed along both walls

settings.label: Trade terms
settings.value: Write to us for trade prices and terms.

settings.label: Samples
settings.value: A [sample_size] sample of any rug costs [sample_price]. For a studio library, ask us for the sample box and for the box of colour poms.

settings.label: Specification
settings.value: The page of each rug lists its craft level, materials, pile and pile height. Every rug is made to measure, up to [max_size].

settings.title: Start with your idea
settings.text: See a price guide for the rug you have in mind, or talk to us first.
settings.image_alt: A hand letting a ball of yarn fall onto a carved brown rug
